driverSource:
"""Two scratch originals and a bounded audit-disabled ODA canonicalization.

This is advisory producer/field-role research, not support qualification.
No saved source is mutated, repaired, or resaved.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
import plistlib
import sys
import time

root = Path.cwd()
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.pycache_prefix = str(out / "absent-bytecode-cache")
assert not Path(sys.pycache_prefix).exists()
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "tools"))
import ezdxf
from ezdxf.entities.material import Material, acdb_material
from bounded_process import run_bounded
from qualify_material_source_order import selected_physical_records


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def physical(path, selected_name):
    """Reuse peer tag loader; attach raw ASCII byte spans without assigning roles."""
    selected = [record for scope, record in selected_physical_records(path, False)
                if scope == "OBJECTS" and record[0].value == "MATERIAL"
                and record.get_first_value(1) == selected_name]
    assert len(selected) == 1
    tags = [[t.code, t.value] for t in selected[0]]
    data = path.read_bytes()
    lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    assert len(lines) % 2 == 0
    offset, raw, records, current = 0, [], [], None
    for i in range(0, len(lines), 2):
        code = int(lines[i].strip())
        value = lines[i + 1].rstrip(b"\r\n").decode("utf-8", "strict")
        end = offset + len(lines[i]) + len(lines[i + 1])
        pair = dict(code=code, value=value, begin=offset, end=end,
                    codeLine=i + 1, valueLine=i + 2)
        if code == 0:
            if current:
                current["end"] = offset
                records.append(current)
            current = dict(kind=value, begin=offset, fields=[])
        elif current is not None:
            current["fields"].append(pair)
        offset = end
    if current:
        current["end"] = offset
        records.append(current)
    matches = [r for r in records if r["kind"] == "MATERIAL"
               and any(p["code"] == 1 and p["value"] == selected_name for p in r["fields"])]
    assert len(matches) == 1
    raw = matches[0]
    assert [p["code"] for p in raw["fields"]] == [p[0] for p in tags[1:]]
    return dict(path=str(path), sha256=digest(path), bytes=len(data),
                handle=selected[0].get_first_value(5),
                owner=selected[0].get_first_value(330, None),
                literalTags=tags, rawSpans=raw,
                beforeOrdinaryDocumentSetup=True, roleInterpretation="none")


assert ezdxf.__version__ == "1.4.5"
source_dir, target_dir = out / "originals", out / "oda-canonical"
source_dir.mkdir()
target_dir.mkdir()
adapter = Material.DXFATTRIBS.get("specular_color_method")
assert adapter is acdb_material.attribs["specular_color_method"]
assert adapter.code == 73
adapter.code = 76  # normative generation schema, before document creation/save
intent = {
    "diffuse_map_blend_factor": 0.25, "diffuse_map_source": 0,
    "diffuse_map_file_name": "peer-diffuse-sentinel.png",
    "diffuse_map_projection_method": 2, "diffuse_map_tiling_method": 2,
    "diffuse_map_auto_transform_method": 2,
    "normal_map_blend_factor": 0.75, "normal_map_source": 1,
    "normal_map_file_name": "peer-normal-sentinel.png",
    "normal_map_projection_method": 4, "normal_map_tiling_method": 3,
    "normal_map_auto_transform_method": 4,
    "specular_color_method": 0,
}
report = dict(schema="libdxfrw-material-independent-role-readiness-v1",
    qualificationEligible=False, supportClaimsPromoted=False,
    producer=dict(name="ezdxf", version=ezdxf.__version__,
        executable=sys.executable, executableSha256=digest(sys.executable),
        sourceSchemaAdapter=dict(attribute="specular_color_method", oldCode=73,
            code=76, appliedBeforeDocumentCreation=True,
            rationale="Autodesk MATERIAL specular color method is code76; pinned producer has code73")),
    exclusions=dict(trackedEdits=False, libraryBuilds=False, sourcePostSaveMutation=False,
        explicitAudit=False, explicitRecovery=False, ordinaryDocumentRead=False,
        nativeRenderingQualified=False),
    priorLineage=dict(originalWrong73=str(root / "build/rpp5gh-evidence/original-peer/peer-AC1027-asc.dxf"),
        originalWrong73Sha256="6fc2bbf216bf46a49c952887920ce5d56a4b25dc9cde70c4d9fa0b5c03a5b5b2",
        wrongRoleValue1Workaround=str(root / "build/rpp5gh-evidence/peer-AC1027-asc.dxf"),
        wrongRoleValue1WorkaroundSha256="9bcc7df6e33dc748a2d5d1fb292c835e851dbd491be0bbdffe2262f289ca4bbc",
        preserved=True, newSourceIsSeparateNormativeGeneration=True),
    primaryReferences=[
        "https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2025/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-E540C5BB-E166-44FA-B36C-5C739878B272.htm",
        "https://www.opendesign.com/guestfiles/oda_file_converter"],
    sources=[])
for explicit in (True, False):
    label = "explicit465" if explicit else "omitted-boundary"
    name = "PeerRole-" + label
    doc = ezdxf.new("R2013")
    material = doc.materials.new(name)
    material.dxf.update(intent)
    if explicit:
        material.dxf.normal_map_strength = 0.625
    assert not material.dxf.hasattr("luminance")
    assert not material.dxf.hasattr("normal_map_method")
    assert material.refraction_mapper_matrix is None
    doc.modelspace().add_line((1, 2, 3), (4, 5, 6), dxfattribs={
        "material_handle": material.dxf.handle})
    frozen = dict(label=label, selectedName=name, materialHandle=material.dxf.handle,
        materialOwner=material.dxf.owner,
        typedStoredBeforeSave={key: material.dxf.get(key) for key in intent},
        normalStrengthStored=material.dxf.hasattr("normal_map_strength"),
        normalStrength=material.dxf.get("normal_map_strength"),
        normalMethodStored=False, luminanceStored=False,
        refractionMatrixPresent=False,
        authoring="typed attributes before first and only source save",
        imageFilesCreated=False, textureRenderingClaim=False)
    (out / (label + "-intent-before-save.json")).write_text(json.dumps(frozen, indent=2) + "\n")
    source = source_dir / (label + ".dxf")
    doc.saveas(source, fmt="asc")
    frozen["source"] = physical(source, name)
    taglist = frozen["source"]["literalTags"]
    assert [t for t in taglist if t[0] == 76] == [[76, 0]]
    assert not any(t[0] in (147, 464) for t in taglist)
    assert [t for t in taglist if t[0] == 465] == ([[465, 0.625]] if explicit else [])
    assert [t[1] for t in taglist if t[0] == 42] == [0.25, 0.75]
    report["sources"].append(frozen)

oda = Path("/Applications/ODAFileConverter.app/Contents/MacOS/ODAFileConverter")
bundle = oda.parent.parent
plist = plistlib.loads((bundle / "Info.plist").read_bytes())
argv = [str(oda), str(source_dir), str(target_dir), "ACAD2013", "DXF", "0", "0", "*.dxf"]
report["oda"] = dict(executable=str(oda), executableSha256=digest(oda),
    version=plist.get("CFBundleShortVersionString"),
    buildStamp=(bundle / "tx/build.txt").read_text().strip(),
    argv=argv, auditFlag=0, recursionFlag=0, timeoutSeconds=20, outputLimitPerStream=65536,
    sourceFormat="DXF ASCII AC1027", outputFormat="DXF ASCII AC1027",
    conversionRole="independent canonicalization; output is separate producer lineage")
start = time.monotonic()
try:
    result = run_bounded(argv, timeout=20, output_limit=65536)
    report["oda"].update(returncode=result.returncode, seconds=time.monotonic() - start,
        stdout=result.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"),
        stderr=result.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
except Exception as exc:
    report["oda"].update(exceptionType=type(exc).__name__, exception=str(exc),
        seconds=time.monotonic() - start)
for row in report["sources"]:
    source = Path(row["source"]["path"])
    assert digest(source) == row["source"]["sha256"]
    path = target_dir / source.name
    row["outputExists"] = path.is_file()
    if path.is_file():
        try:
            row["output"] = physical(path, row["selectedName"])
        except Exception as exc:
            row["outputProjectionFailure"] = dict(type=type(exc).__name__, reason=str(exc),
                sha256=digest(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size)
    row["sourceUnchangedAfterOda"] = True
report["producer"]["loadedModules"] = {
    name: dict(path=str(Path(module.__file__).resolve()), sha256=digest(module.__file__))
    for name, module in sorted(sys.modules.items())
    if name.startswith("ezdxf") and getattr(module, "__file__", None)
    and Path(module.__file__).is_file()}
report["bindings"] = {str(path): digest(path) for path in (
    Path(__file__), root / "tools/qualify_material_source_order.py", root / "tools/bounded_process.py")}
for old in ("originalWrong73", "wrongRoleValue1Workaround"):
    assert digest(report["priorLineage"][old]) == report["priorLineage"][old + "Sha256"]
path = out / "experiment.json"
path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(dict(report=str(path), sha256=digest(path),
    oda=report["oda"], outputs=[dict(label=r["label"], exists=r["outputExists"],
        projected="output" in r, projectionFailure=r.get("outputProjectionFailure"))
        for r in report["sources"]]), indent=2))

"""One bounded ODA retry with unchanged originals and retained first failure."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time

root = Path.cwd()
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.pycache_prefix = str(out / "absent-bytecode-cache")
assert not Path(sys.pycache_prefix).exists()
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "tools"))
from bounded_process import run_bounded
from qualify_material_source_order import selected_physical_records

# Reuse exactly the original scratch observer functions without rerunning authoring.
driver = out / "experiment.py"
module = ast.parse(driver.read_text())
functions = ast.Module(body=[node for node in module.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
                            and node.name in ("digest", "physical")], type_ignores=[])
exec(compile(functions, str(driver), "exec"), globals())
first_path = out / "experiment.json"
first = json.loads(first_path.read_text())
assert digest(driver) == first["bindings"][str(driver)]
for row in first["sources"]:
    assert digest(row["source"]["path"]) == row["source"]["sha256"]
target = out / "oda-canonical-native-services"
target.mkdir()
argv = first["oda"]["argv"].copy()
argv[2] = str(target)
report = dict(schema="libdxfrw-material-independent-role-native-services-retry-v1",
    qualificationEligible=False, supportClaimsPromoted=False,
    firstAttempt=dict(path=str(first_path), sha256=digest(first_path),
                      returncode=first["oda"].get("returncode")),
    reason="Cocoa pasteboard/hiservices process abort in sandbox; same original inputs, separate output directory",
    originalSourceReauthored=False, sourceMutation=False, auditRequested=False,
    explicitRecovery=False, trackedEdits=False, libraryBuilds=False,
    argv=argv, timeoutSeconds=20, outputLimitPerStream=65536,
    odaSha256=digest(argv[0]), originalSources=first["sources"], outputs=[])
assert report["odaSha256"] == first["oda"]["executableSha256"]
start = time.monotonic()
try:
    result = run_bounded(argv, timeout=20, output_limit=65536)
    report.update(returncode=result.returncode,
        stdout=result.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"),
        stderr=result.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"), seconds=time.monotonic() - start)
except Exception as exc:
    report.update(exceptionType=type(exc).__name__, exception=str(exc), seconds=time.monotonic() - start)
for row in first["sources"]:
    source = Path(row["source"]["path"])
    assert digest(source) == row["source"]["sha256"]
    path = target / source.name
    observation = dict(label=row["label"], exists=path.is_file(), sourceUnchanged=True)
    if path.is_file():
        try:
            observation["physical"] = physical(path, row["selectedName"])
        except Exception as exc:
            observation["projectionFailure"] = dict(type=type(exc).__name__, reason=str(exc),
                sha256=digest(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size)
    report["outputs"].append(observation)
report["retryDriverSha256"] = digest(__file__)
path = out / "native-services-retry.json"
path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(dict(report=str(path), sha256=digest(path),
    returncode=report.get("returncode"), exception=report.get("exception"),
    seconds=report["seconds"], outputs=[dict(label=r["label"], exists=r["exists"],
        projected="physical" in r, failure=r.get("projectionFailure")) for r in report["outputs"]]), indent=2))
limitations: The failed positive control disqualifies this particular ODA conversion route as a distinguishing role oracle; it does not establish why ODA produced these tags or generalize to all ODA workflows.
No native rendering or normal-map semantic qualification, parser widening, whole-document support or claim promotion follows.
Original from-scratch drawings and converted output stay in scratch and are not committed.
